newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mobile plans new "N" ordinary shares.
newsitem.headline: Mobile plans new "N" ordinary shares.

text.p: Mobile Industries Ltd said on Thursday that it planned to create a new class of "N" ordinary shares in the ratio of two "N" ordinary shares for every ordinary share held.

It said in a statement that this would "cater for the different aspirations of those investors who wish to participate in the control of Mobile, and those who wish to enjoy capital growth without participation control."
It would also increase the tradeability of Mobile shares and allow for greater flexibility in Mobile's capital structure.
A circular containing details would be sent to shareholders on October 28 and a general meeting to approve the new shares would be held on November 19.
Mobile said it planned to issue the new shares to shareholders registered on November 22.
